name: OMathFunctions
description: Represents a collection of functions or structures that Microsoft Word supports, such as fractions, integrals, sums, and radicals.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathFunctions object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of items in the OMathFunctions collection. Read-only Long.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an OMathFunction object that represents the specified item in the collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Specifies the ordinal position of the object within the collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Range As Range, Type As WdOMathFunctionType, [NumArgs As Variant], [NumCols As Variant]) As OMathFunction
methods.description: Inserts a new structure, such as a fraction, into an equation at the specified position and returns an OMathFunction object that represents the structure.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The place at which to insert an equation.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of equation to insert.

parameters.name: NumArgs
parameters.description: The number of arguments in the equation.

parameters.name: NumCols
parameters.description: The number of columns in the equation.
